LanguageData.RWS_Setting_IncludeDevMode: Show and count endings recorded in development mode
LanguageData.RWS_Setting_AutoImport: Import saves automatically at the title screen
LanguageData.RWS_Setting_WindowSizeHelp: Applied the next time you open Statistics. Font size is unchanged; oversized windows fit the screen.
LanguageData.RWS_WindowError: The statistics window failed to draw. See the log for details.
LanguageData.RWS_NoData: Nothing recorded yet. Figures appear once the save import finishes (Import tab).
LanguageData.RWS_TooltipBasis: Computed from {0} colonies ({1} excluded from totals)
LanguageData.RWS_TooltipMissing: {0} saves that could not be identified or read are not included.
LanguageData.RWS_EndingsTooltipPreInstall: Play from before the mod was installed is counted only from traces left in the saves. A trace means "at least once"; Archonexus and other endings cannot be counted from saves.
LanguageData.RWS_ExcludeTip: A checked colony stays in the list but is left out of all totals.
LanguageData.RWS_HistoricalIntervals_Explanation: Partial evidence from directly linked saves. Each row shows a change between saved ticks. Forks remain separate, and these rows are excluded from lifetime totals.
LanguageData.RWS_HistoricalIntervals_Empty: No directly linked saves with a confirmed increase were found.
LanguageData.RWS_HistoricalIntervals_Error: The historical intervals could not be read.
LanguageData.RWS_Import_NotRunThisSession: No import has run in this session yet.
LanguageData.RWS_Import_CorruptRenamed: The damaged file was kept as {0}.
LanguageData.RWS_Import_ReadOnly: Nothing is written to the record file this session.
LanguageData.RWS_Import_SaveError: Could not write the record file: {0}
LanguageData.RWS_Import_Problems: Saves that failed or could not be identified ({0})
LanguageData.RWS_LoadSource_NewerSchema: record file from a newer version (read-only)
LanguageData.RWS_WealthCoverage: Wealth data from {0} colonies ({1} without data).
LanguageData.RWS_Source_RecoveredLineage: Recovered from save (dev mode unknown, excluded from totals)
LanguageData.RWS_Details_ThroughTip: In-game day of the save the value comes from.
LanguageData.RWS_Details_Note: From {0} colonies (excluded from totals: {1}). Values are computed from the imported saves and may include what happened through dev-mode actions.
LanguageData.RWS_Details_Unattributed: {0} observations that could not be matched to one colony are not included.
LanguageData.RWS_Details_UnrankedTop: No category winner can be established
LanguageData.RWS_Details_AvailabilityNone: None of the selected colonies is applicable to this metric; a missing DLC can explain this only when supported by a saved DLC inventory.
LanguageData.RWS_Details_AvailabilityMissing: 0 eligible colonies have a captured value. The cause is unconfirmed: collection may be disabled or late, the event may not have been captured, or historical import may be unsupported. Do not substitute zero.
LanguageData.RWS_Details_AvailabilitySome: Only some eligible colonies have a captured value. The others are unknown, not zero; the combined value may be partial.
LanguageData.RWS_Details_AvailabilityAll: All eligible colonies have a captured value. This alone does not prove full-campaign or real-game verification.
LanguageData.RWS_Details_AvailabilityPartialPeriod: A captured value may cover only part of the campaign. Do not interpret it as a verified lifetime total.
LanguageData.RWS_Cross_RankedTypeExplanation: Quantity summed by type across independently selected colonies; the ranking may be partial if any recorded breakdown is missing.
LanguageData.RWS_Cross_ContributionExplanation: Measured contribution of this colony to the selected type. Unlisted or missing colonies were not assumed to have zero.
LanguageData.RWS_Details_MissingAcquisitionTip: This may reflect saves predating acquisition, disabled collection, or unavailable source data. Past events must not be backfilled as zero.
LanguageData.RWS_Details_Tip_StartGame: Measured from: the start of the game
LanguageData.RWS_Details_Tip_StartSnapshot: The state at the time of saving.
LanguageData.RWS_Details_Tip_Unknown: There is no data to base it on (saves read before this version, a missing file, an unsupported game version, or unreadable data).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthItemsPeak: Largest item wealth in the history graph (one observation per half day). All colonies: the single highest.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthItemsLatest: Item wealth at the last history observation. All colonies: the sum.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthBuildingsPeak: Largest building wealth in the history graph. All colonies: the single highest.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthBuildingsLatest: Building wealth at the last history observation. All colonies: the sum.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthPawnsPeak: Largest wealth in pawns and animals in the history graph. All colonies: the single highest.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthPawnsLatest: Wealth in pawns and animals at the last history observation. All colonies: the sum.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthTotalMean: Mean of the valid total wealth observations. All colonies: weighted by the number of observations.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthTotalFirst: Total wealth at the first observation of a history that is complete from the start. One colony only.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthTotalNet: Total wealth at the last observation minus the first; negative if it fell. All colonies: the sum.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthTotalPeakDay: Nominal day of the first observation at the peak total wealth (one observation per half day). One colony only.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthTotalMaxGainHalfDay: Largest rise of total wealth between two consecutive observations; 0 if it never rose.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthTotalMaxLossHalfDay: Largest fall of total wealth between two consecutive observations; 0 if it never fell.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthTotalMaxLossRateHal: Largest (before − after) ÷ before between two consecutive observations, leaving out intervals that start at 0.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthTotalMaxGain15D: Largest rise of total wealth between observations 30 apart (15 days); periods with a gap are not used.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthTotalMaxLoss15D: Largest fall of total wealth between observations 30 apart (15 days); periods with a gap are not used.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthTotalMaxGrowthRateY: Largest (after − before) ÷ before between observations 120 apart (one year); negative if wealth always fell.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthTotalLongestGrowth: Longest run of observations in which total wealth rose every time; equal values and gaps end a run.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthTotalFirst100K: Nominal day of the first observation with total wealth of 100,000 or more. All colonies: the earliest.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthTotalFirst1M: Nominal day of the first observation with total wealth of 1,000,000 or more. All colonies: the earliest.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WealthBuildingsMaxShare: Largest building wealth ÷ total wealth at the same observation.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FreeColonistsMean: Mean of the observed number of free colonists. All colonies: weighted by the number of observations.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FreeColonistsMin: Smallest observed number of free colonists. All colonies: the smallest.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FreeColonistsFirst10: Nominal day of the first observation with 10 or more free colonists. All colonies: the earliest.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_PrisonersMean: Mean of the observed number of prisoners. All colonies: weighted by the number of observations.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_MoodMean: Mean of the observed average colonist mood (0–100). A 0, recorded when there are no colonists, is treated as missing. Not weighted by colonist count.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_MoodMin: Lowest valid observation of the average colonist mood.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_MoodMax: Highest valid observation of the average colonist mood.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_MoodBelow50Days: Half-day intervals with both ends valid whose starting mood is below 50, ÷ 2. All colonies: the sum.
LanguageData.RWS_Metric_MoodAtLeast80Days: Days with mood at 80% or more (observed)
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_MoodAtLeast80Days: Half-day intervals with both ends valid whose starting mood is 80 or more, ÷ 2. All colonies: the sum.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_DeathsPerYear: Colonist deaths ÷ elapsed years (1 year = 60 days) in the same save. All colonies: total deaths ÷ total years.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidsPerYear: Enemy raids ÷ elapsed years (1 year = 60 days) in the same save. All colonies: total raids ÷ total years.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ModsLatest: Active mods listed in the latest save, including Core and DLCs. One colony only.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ModsPeak: Most mods in any imported save of this colony. One colony only.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ModsMin: Fewest mods in any imported save of this colony. One colony only.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_QuestSuccess: Accepted quests that succeeded and are still in the save. Quests the game removed cannot be counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_QuestFailure: Accepted quests that failed and are still in the save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_QuestSuccessRate: Successes ÷ (successes + failures). All colonies: the summed numerators ÷ the summed denominators.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_QuestSuccessByRoot: Succeeded quests by quest type (def name). Click to show the breakdown.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_QuestExpired: Quest offers still in the save that expired without being accepted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_QuestAccepted: Quests still in the save that were accepted (including automatically), ongoing ones included.
LanguageData.RWS_Metric_QuestSuccessDurationMean: Mean days of succeeded quests (acceptance to cleanup)
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_QuestSuccessDurationMean: Mean days from acceptance to the start of cleanup for succeeded quests; quests without an acceptance time are left out.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_QuestSuccessDurationMin: Fewest days in the same sample as the mean.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_QuestSuccessDurationMax: Most days in the same sample as the mean.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankDaysByBiome: Total colony survival days grouped by the game's original starting biome; never uses the current settlement biome.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankEndingsByBiome: Accepted endings grouped by the immutable start-tile biome; colonies with unknown origin are excluded and coverage is partial.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankKillsToDeaths: Confirmed hostile kills divided by free-colonist deaths in the same recorded checkpoint interval. Missing paired inputs are excluded; a zero denominator is undefined.
LanguageData.RWS_Metric_RankMostKills: Most enemy kills in one colony
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankMostKills: Maximum confirmed hostile kills in a single colony, from its selected checkpoint; missing input does not count as zero.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankDeathFree: Largest measured death-free interval in any one colony, based on completed intervals from the selected checkpoint.
LanguageData.RWS_Metric_RankMostCrafting: Most manufactured items in one colony
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankMostCrafting: Maximum confirmed crafted item count in one colony from the selected checkpoint.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankLargestSale: Maximum confirmed sale amount for one transaction in a colony, compared across colonies.
LanguageData.RWS_Metric_RankMostResearch: Most completed research in one colony
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankMostResearch: Largest number of completed research projects in a colony's save-time snapshot, not a count of research completion events.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankMinPartyAtEnding: Fewest participants the game confirmed when an ending happened: the occupied cryptosleep caskets of a ship launch, the colonists sent on the Royal Ascent shuttle, or the colonists who transcended at the archonexus. Other endings, and endings recorded before this was stored, have no value.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankByDifficultyDays: Colony days summed by the difficulty of each colony's furthest point; changes of difficulty during play are not tracked. Click to show the breakdown.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankByDifficultyEndings: Endings counted as on the Overview (dev-mode setting, traces as at least once), by the difficulty of each colony's furthest point.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankByPermadeathDays: Colony days summed by whether each colony's furthest point is in permadeath mode.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankByPermadeathEndings: Endings counted as on the Overview, by whether each colony's furthest point is in permadeath mode.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankPopulationPeak: The highest of the game's greatest-population counters across colonies, and its colony.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankFastestEnding: The ending recorded during play with the fewest in-game days, and its colony. Pre-install traces, whose time is unknown, are left out.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankNetWealthPerYear: The colonies' net wealth changes summed, ÷ the years their histories span, summed (histories of one observation are left out).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankTopScenario: The most endings for one scenario name of the colonies' furthest points, and the name; ties are listed together. Click to show the breakdown.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankDaysByStoryteller: Colony days summed by the storyteller of each colony's furthest point.
LanguageData.RWS_Metric_RankPlaytimePeak: Colony with the most play time
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankPlaytimePeak: The longest real play time of one colony, and the colony.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankWealthPerColonist: Largest total wealth ÷ free colonists (at least one) at the same observation, and its colony; only where both histories are complete from the start.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankMinDeathsAtEnding: The fewest colonist deaths at the moment an ending was recorded, and the colony. Endings recorded before this version have no death count and are left out.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RankZeroDeathEndings: Endings whose colonist death count was 0 when recorded. Endings without a death count are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ResearchLiveCompleted: Research projects that went from unfinished to finished since recording began, each counted once. Not the number of projects finished at save time.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ResearchLiveCompletedTick: Per project completed while recorded, the game day it was first finished. Shown per colony only.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ResearchLiveDurationMin: Fewest days from the first real work on a project to its completion, including pauses. Projects whose start was not seen are left out.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ResearchLiveDurationMax: Most days in the same sample as the shortest.
LanguageData.RWS_Metric_ResearchLiveFirstDay: Days to the first research completion
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ResearchLiveFirstDay: The game day of the first completion, only when recorded from the start of the game.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_MentalBreaks: Mood-caused mental breaks of free colonists. Breaks from drugs, genes, psycasts or dev tools are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_MentalBreaksByDef: The mental breaks above, by type (MentalBreakDef).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Inspirations: Inspirations that really started for free colonists. Failed attempts, already-inspired pawns and dev tools are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_HostileKills: Deaths of pawns hostile to the player just before dying, whose cause the damage record attributes to the player's side (colonists, turrets, traps, animals, mechs). Deaths without a known attribution are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_KillsPerPawnMax: The most kills credited to one player pawn; the breakdown names the holder (by id). Kills known only by their cause are not credited to anyone.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_KillsByVictimKind: Enemy kills split into humanlike, insect, mechanoid and other.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RangedKills: Enemy kills made with ranged weapons (explosions count as explosive).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_MeleeKills: Enemy kills made with an equipped melee weapon.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_UnarmedKills: Enemy kills made with melee attacks without a weapon.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ExplosiveKills: Enemy kills whose killing damage was an explosion.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_EnvironmentKills: Enemy kills by fire or other environmental damage that the record attributes to the player's side. Natural deaths and unattributed ones are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_TurretKills: Enemy kills whose attacker was a player turret.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_TrapKills: Enemy kills caused by a player trap.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_TameAnimalKills: Enemy kills whose attacker was a player animal.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_PlayerMechKills: Enemy kills whose attacker was a player mechanoid (Biotech).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_DeathCauses: Free colonist deaths by the culprit health condition (hediff) or the killing damage type. Deaths with neither are "unknown".
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_DeathsByRaid: Free colonist deaths split into those caused by a raider, other known causes, and unknown. While raids are not recorded, they are unknown.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_DiseaseDeaths: Free colonist deaths whose culprit was a sickness (a condition the game treats as making the pawn sick). Deaths merely accompanied by a disease are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_DiseaseDeathRate: Deaths from disease ÷ free colonist deaths with a known cause.
LanguageData.RWS_Metric_LongestDeathGap: Longest time without a colonist death
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_LongestDeathGap: The longest interval between two consecutive free colonist deaths while recorded. The time before the first and after the last death is not an interval.
LanguageData.RWS_Metric_FirstDeathDay: Days to the first colonist death
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FirstDeathDay: The game day of the first free colonist death, only when recorded from the start of the game.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_OldestDeathAge: The highest biological age of a free colonist just before dying. The same value as the longest-lived colonist (P-010).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_CaravanMemberDeaths: Free colonists who died while in a player caravan.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ColonyAnimalDeaths: Deaths of animals that belonged to the player just before dying.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ColonyAnimalRaidDeaths: Colony animal deaths whose attacker belonged to a tracked raid.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ColonistsDowned: Times a free colonist went from not downed to downed. Instant deaths without a downing are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_EnemiesDowned: Times a pawn hostile to the player went down; going down again after recovering is another time. The same value as enemies incapacitated (B-002).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ToxicDowns: Free colonist downs directly caused by toxic buildup (Biotech).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_SocialFightDowns: Free colonist downs caused directly by the opponent of a social fight.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidsByArrivalMode: Successful enemy raids by arrival mode (PawnsArrivalModeDef). The total is the number of raids.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidsByFaction: Successful enemy raids by the attacking faction's def.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidPawnsMax: The most enemy pawns generated for one successful raid. Raid points are a separate row.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidPointsMax: The highest final raid points used to generate a successful raid.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidKillsMax: The most kills the player's side made among one tracked raid's pawns while that raid lasted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidBreaches: Raids with a breaching strategy (ImmediateAttackBreaching, ImmediateAttackBreachingSmart). Sappers are not included.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidDrops: Raids arriving by drop pod (EdgeDrop, EdgeDropGroups, CenterDrop, RandomDrop).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Infestations: Successful insect hive infestations (Infestation, DeepDrillInfestation). Other insect-related events are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_MechClusters: Successful mech cluster incidents (Royalty). Ordinary mechanoid raids are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidLongestGap: The longest interval between two consecutive raids while recorded, not counting before the first or after the last. The same value as the largest raid interval (N2-C-002).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidMeanGap: The mean of the same intervals; overall, weighted by the number of intervals.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidFirstDay: The game day of the first raid, only when recorded from the start of the game.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidsRetreated: Tracked raids that ended with some enemies leaving the map alive.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidsWiped: Tracked raids that ended with every enemy killed and none retreating. A raid with prisoners has another outcome.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidRepelledRate: Raids that retreated or were wiped out ÷ tracked raids with a decided outcome. Raids whose outcome is unknown (e.g. the map vanished) are left out.
LanguageData.RWS_Metric_RaidRepelledNoDown: Raids repelled without a colonist down
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidRepelledNoDown: Repelled raids during which no free colonist went down on the same map.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidDurationMean: The mean days from arrival until the last tracked enemy was out of the fight, over raids with a decided outcome.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidDurationMax: The most days in the same sample.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidDurationMinRepelled: The fewest days of a raid that retreated or was wiped out.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FirstJoins: Pawns who became free colonists for the first time, other than the starting colonists and births. Each pawn counts once.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_JoinRoutes: New members split into recruited prisoners, emancipated slaves and other routes.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_PrisonerRecruits: Pawns who were prisoners of the colony and joined for the first time by recruitment.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_HumanBirths: Humanlike children born alive on the player's side (Biotech). Stillbirths are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_JoinAgeMean: The mean biological age of new members when they joined.
LanguageData.RWS_Metric_FirstJoinDay: Days to the first new member
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FirstJoinDay: The game day of the first new member, only when recorded from the start of the game.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_SlavesFreed: Slaves whose slave status was lifted (emancipated). Not the same as releasing prisoners.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Kidnaps: Times a free colonist was kidnapped into a faction's captives.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_KidnapRescues: Kidnapped colonists who came back through a confirmed route (ransom). Other routes are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_CaptiveMax: The longest captivity from kidnapping to return that was tracked.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_LifeMean: The mean biological age of free colonists at death. Living colonists are not included.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_TenureMean: The mean days from joining (or the start of the game) to death or leaving, where both ends were tracked. Ongoing stays are not included.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FirstSkill20: (Pawn, skill) pairs of free colonists that first reached 20 through learning while recorded. Dropping and reaching 20 again counts once.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_JoinGainPeak: The largest increase of a skill over its level at joining. Pawns whose level at joining is not known are not included.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Marriages: Pairs that became spouses; both sides' notifications count as one.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Divorces: Spouse relations ended by divorce. Bereavement and other relation removals are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Lovers: Pairs that became lovers; both sides' notifications count as one.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_SocialFights: Social fights started; two pawns make one fight.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_PrisonBreaks: Prison breaks started, however many prisoners escaped.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_PrisonersReleased: Prisoners of the colony whose release completed. Escapes are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_PrisonersCaptured: Hostile pawns captured into prisoners of the colony.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_AnimalBonds: Bonds formed between a colonist and a colony animal.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_AnimalsTamed: Wild animals that became the player's through successful taming. Purchases are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_AnimalBirths: Player animals born or hatched alive. Separate from humanlike births.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_AnimalsSlaughtered: Colony animal deaths by designated slaughter.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_AnimalsHunted: Wild animals designated for hunting and killed by a player pawn. Incidental fights are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_CraftedUnits: Stack counts of the main and side products of the player's finished bills, including cooking and art; mining, harvests and mech gestation are not included.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_CraftQuality: The crafted items above by quality; items without quality are "none".
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_CraftBestQuality: The highest quality of a crafted item (0 = awful … 6 = legendary); the breakdown names it.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_CraftBestPrice: The highest market value of one crafted item when it was made; not its sale price.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Sculptures: Crafted items that are art (sculptures and the like).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_MealsByDef: Finished meals among the crafted items, by type (ThingDef).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_UniqueCraftedDefs: The number of item types (ThingDef) crafted at least once.
LanguageData.RWS_Metric_CraftDailyPeak: Most items crafted in a day
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_CraftDailyPeak: The most items crafted in one game day; only days recorded from start to end count.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_BestCrafter: The crafted count of the pawn who crafted most; the breakdown names them (by id).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_BestCook: The meal count of the pawn who cooked most; the breakdown names them (by id).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_HarvestUnits: Stack counts of the main products player pawns harvested; additional yields are not included.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_HarvestByCrop: The harvest by the crop it came from (plant ThingDef); harvests whose crop is not known are "unknown".
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_TopCrop: The crop with the largest harvest, and that amount.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_HarvestYearPeak: The largest harvest in one game year; only years recorded throughout count.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_BestHarvester: The harvest of the pawn who harvested most; the breakdown names them (by id).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_HarvestFailures: Plants whose harvest by a player pawn actually failed. Not the same as plants dying.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_CropsSownDefs: The number of crop types sown at least once.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_MiningUnits: Stack counts of what player pawns' mining produced.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_BestMiner: The amount mined by the pawn who mined most; the breakdown names them (by id).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Constructions: Player construction frames completed into buildings. Reinstallations and blueprints are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ConstructionMaterials: The materials completed frames held, by type (ThingDef). Different materials are not added together.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_BestBuilder: The completed constructions of the pawn who completed most; the breakdown names them (by id).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ConstructionFailures: Times a construction failed. Cancellations are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Deconstructions: Player buildings whose deconstruction order completed. Deconstruction for a replacing blueprint is not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Repairs: Times a repair job brought a player building back to full hit points.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_PodsLaunched: Player transport pods launched (pods, not launches).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FoodSpoiled: Stack counts of player food destroyed by rotting. Burning and eating are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FoodNutrition: The nutrition free colonists actually took in by eating.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FoodHarvestPerCell: Main harvest of crops standing in growing zones divided by the growing-zone cells integrated over the same time (cell-days). Hydroponics and wild plants are not included.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_TradeDeals: Deals in which at least one non-currency item changed hands. Empty deals, gifts and failures are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_TradeVisitingCaravan: Deals with traders visiting the colony on foot. Trading at other settlements is separate.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_TradeSalesTotal: The contract value of non-currency items sold in completed deals (silver).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_TradeBuysTotal: The contract value of non-currency items bought in completed deals (silver).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_TradeSalesPeak: The largest sale total of one deal.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_TradeBuysPeak: The largest purchase total of one deal.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_TradeSalesPeakUnit: The highest contract value ÷ count of a sold line.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_TradeSalesUnits: Stack counts of non-currency items sold.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_TradeBuysUnits: Stack counts of non-currency items bought.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_TradeTopSold: The item type sold most, and how many.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_TradeTopBought: The item type bought most, and how many.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_TradeSoldDefs: The number of non-currency item types sold.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_TradeBoughtDefs: The number of non-currency item types bought.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_TradePartnerFactionDefs: The number of known faction types traded with; partners without a faction are shown apart as "unknown".
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_GiftGoodwill: The real goodwill increase of the receiving faction around each gift deal; 0 at the limit.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_AllyToHostile: Times a faction's relation went from ally to hostile.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Reconciled: Times a hostile faction's relation became neutral or ally.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_AidRequests: Military aid requests a friendly faction accepted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_AidArrivals: Times friendly reinforcements actually arrived. Not the same as requests.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Tends: Times a tend was performed; one tend of several wounds counts once.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_TendQualityMean: The mean quality applied to each condition a tend treated.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_BestTender: The tends of the pawn who tended most; the breakdown names them (by id). Tends without a known doctor are left out.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_NeutralTends: Tends whose patient was a neutral pawn.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Surgeries: Surgeries with a decided outcome (success or failure). Cancellations are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_SurgerySuccessRate: Successful surgeries ÷ surgeries with a decided outcome.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_BestSurgeon: The successful surgeries of the pawn with most; the breakdown names them (by id).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Implants: Artificial parts and implants installed by successful surgeries.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Rescues: Rescues completed by tucking the pawn into a bed. Ordinary hauling and captures are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_HostileRescues: Rescues of pawns hostile to the player when tucked in.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_AwayRescues: Rescues on a map that is not a player home.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Resurrections: Times a free colonist came back from death.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ResurrectionsPerPawnMax: The most resurrections of one pawn; the breakdown names them (by id).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_DiseaseOnsets: Sicknesses newly added to free colonists.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_DiseaseDurationMean: The mean days from onset to cure of diseases tracked throughout; those removed by death or amputation are left out.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_InfectionRecoveries: Infections that went away by healing; removals by death or amputation are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_InfectionDurationMax: The most days from onset to recovery of an infection tracked throughout.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FoodPoisonings: Times a free colonist got food poisoning.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Addictions: Addictions newly added to free colonists. Severity changes are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Overdoses: Times a free colonist newly overdosed.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Withdrawals: Times a free colonist's drug addiction entered its withdrawal stage (its chemical need fell into withdrawal). Each entry counts once; an addiction already in withdrawal when recording began is not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_HospitalStayMean: Mean days a free colonist lay in the same medical bed, from lying down to getting up. Lying down again in the same bed right away (a job switch in bed) continues the stay; stays ending in death, or begun before recording, give no sample.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_PartsLost: Times a free colonist lost a body part. Child parts lost with it and parts removed by surgery are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Scars: Times a free colonist's injury became permanent.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_InjuriesPerPawnMax: The new injuries of the free colonist with most; the breakdown names them (by id).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WildAnimalInjuries: New injuries of free colonists from wild animal attacks.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ToxicFalloutDays: Days during which at least one toxic fallout was active, overlaps counted once.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_SolarFlares: Solar flares that began; ones already running when recording started are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_SolarFlareDays: Days during which at least one solar flare was active, overlaps counted once; not per-device downtime.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_CropBlights: Successful crop blight incidents; not the number of blighted plants.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Meteors: Successful meteorite incidents; not the number of pieces.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_Fires: Fires started, other than by spreading, in a cell without fire on a player home map.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_BuildingsBurned: Completed player buildings destroyed directly by fire damage.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_CaravanDepartures: Player caravans newly formed by leaving a map. Merges and splits are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_CaravansLost: Tracked caravans whose every member died.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_CaravanTiles: Steps of player caravans to an adjacent tile on foot. Teleports are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_CaravanUniqueTiles: Distinct tiles (layer and tile) reached on foot; a tile visited again counts once.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_CaravanLongestExpedition: The most days from departure to returning to a player home of an expedition tracked throughout; split or merged ones are left out.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_CaravanLongestDistance: The most tiles walked in one completed expedition.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_CaravanConcurrentMax: The most player caravans that existed at once, moving or not.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_SitesCleared: Enemy faction settlements destroyed by the player's victory.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_SettlementsFounded: New player settlements founded from a caravan or an existing map. The starting settlement, moving the colony and gravship landings are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_SettlementsAbandoned: Player settlements abandoned by choice. Automatic removals such as a gravship takeoff are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_AncientDangersOpened: Sealed ancient shrines (the ancient dangers of player settlement maps) whose interior was opened, each once. A shrine counts when the game would consider it revealed: the fog over its centre cleared. Other walls broken or enemies appearing are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ColonyStartingBiome: Biome DefName at the game's immutable starting tile, not the current colony site; unknown when the world tile cannot be resolved.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ResearchSnapshotFinished: Number of registered research projects completed at the last successful save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ResearchSnapshotFinishedR: Completed projects divided by all registered research projects at the last successful save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ResearchSnapshotTechPeak: Highest technical level among completed registered research projects at the last successful save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FactionSnapshotRelations: Counts of eligible active factions allied or hostile to the player, at the last successful save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FactionSnapshotGoodwillRa: Minimum and maximum base goodwill of eligible active factions that support goodwill. Permanently hostile factions contribute to faction counts, not goodwill.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RosterFree: Living free colonists at a successful save, from eligible living pawns (peak values span saved observations).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RosterPrisoners: Living colony prisoners at a successful save, from eligible living pawns (peak values span saved observations).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RosterSlaves: Living colony slaves at a successful save. Historical save recovery reports a partial lower bound only when a saved slave status and player ownership are confirmed.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RosterAnimals: Colony animals at a successful save, from eligible living pawns (peak values span saved observations).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RosterMechs: Colony mechanoids at a successful save, from eligible living pawns (peak values span saved observations).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RosterAugmentedPeak: Highest augmented colonists at a successful save, from eligible living pawns (peak values span saved observations).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RosterSkill20PawnsPeak: Highest colonists with skill 20 at a successful save, from eligible living pawns (peak values span saved observations).
LanguageData.RWS_Metric_RosterSkill20PerPawnPeak: Most max-level skills on one colonist
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RosterSkill20PerPawnPeak: Most max-level skills on one colonist at a successful save, from eligible living pawns (peak values span saved observations).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RosterOldest: Oldest living colonist at a successful save, from eligible living pawns (peak values span saved observations).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RosterAnimalDefsPeak: Highest colony animal species at a successful save, from eligible living pawns (peak values span saved observations).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RosterPassions: Colonist passions by skill at a successful save, from eligible living pawns (peak values span saved observations).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RosterAgeMean: Mean living colonist age at a successful save, from eligible living pawns (peak values span saved observations).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RosterInjuredPeak: Highest simultaneously injured colonists at a successful save, from eligible living pawns (peak values span saved observations).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FacilitiesHomeMaps: Most loaded home maps across loaded player home maps at a successful save. Peaks are selected across recorded saves.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FacilitiesTurrets: Most installed turrets across loaded player home maps at a successful save. Peaks are selected across recorded saves.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FacilitiesGrowingCells: Largest growing-zone area across loaded player home maps at a successful save. Peaks are selected across recorded saves.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FacilitiesGeneration: Highest rated generating capacity across loaded player home maps at a successful save. Peaks are selected across recorded saves.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FacilitiesBattery: Highest rated battery capacity across loaded player home maps at a successful save. Peaks are selected across recorded saves.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FacilitiesOutdoorTempMin: Lowest observed outdoor temperature across loaded player home maps at a successful save. Peaks are selected across recorded saves.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FacilitiesOutdoorTempMax: Highest observed outdoor temperature across loaded player home maps at a successful save. Peaks are selected across recorded saves.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_StockFoodLatest: Food nutrition at last save measured on loaded player home maps and eligible owned containers at a successful save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_StockSilverLatest: Silver at last save measured on loaded player home maps and eligible owned containers at a successful save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_StockMaterialsLatest: Construction materials by type measured on loaded player home maps and eligible owned containers at a successful save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_StockWeaponsPeak: Maximum owned weapons measured on loaded player home maps and eligible owned containers at a successful save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_StockWeaponDefsPeak: Maximum weapon types measured on loaded player home maps and eligible owned containers at a successful save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_StockLegendaryWeaponsPeak: Maximum legendary weapons measured on loaded player home maps and eligible owned containers at a successful save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_StockPersonaWeaponsPeak: Maximum persona weapons measured on loaded player home maps and eligible owned containers at a successful save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_StockMedicinePeak: Maximum medicines in stock measured on loaded player home maps and eligible owned containers at a successful save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_StockFoodMin: Minimum food nutrition measured on loaded player home maps and eligible owned containers at a successful save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RoyaltyPsylinkPeak: Highest psylink level observed at a successful save; requires the relevant DLC.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_BiotechPollutionPeak: Maximum polluted cells observed at a successful save; requires the relevant DLC.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_BiotechBandwidthPeak: Highest used mechanitor bandwidth observed at a successful save; requires the relevant DLC.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RoyaltyPermitUses: Royal permits confirmed used by an eligible player colonist; cancelled selections do not count.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RoyaltyPsycasts: Royalty psychic abilities activated successfully by free player colonists; unconfirmed targeting does not count.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RoyaltyQuestSuccess: Accepted quests still kept in the save that ended in success and that the Quests tab shows as related to the Empire, counted at each successful save. Quests the game has removed are not included; not a lifetime total.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RoyaltyTitleGrants: Royal titles granted confirmed during the recorded Royalty event period.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RoyaltyHighestTitle: Highest royal title confirmed during the recorded Royalty event period.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RoyaltyHonor: Imperial honor gained and spent confirmed during the recorded Royalty event period.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_IdeologyConversions: Number of observed player-side transitions from an existing ideology to a different ideology; excludes pawn initialization.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_IdeologyRitualResults: Confirmed Ideology rituals by outcome Def; interrupted rituals use a separate bucket.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_IdeologyRitualRate: Confirmed successes divided by rituals with a classified success or failure; interruptions are excluded.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_IdeologyConversionDays: Average days from a confirmed explicit conversion action to reaching its matching target ideology.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_IdeologyAppointments: Confirmed new assignments of ideology leader or specialist roles to player-side colonists; repeat assignments excluded.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_OdysseyFlights: Completed gravship flights from authoritative completed player flights, not launch or preview data.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_OdysseyDistance: Total completed flight distance from authoritative completed player flights, not launch or preview data.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_OdysseyUniqueTiles: Distinct landing locations from authoritative completed player flights, not launch or preview data.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_OdysseyNewMaps: Landings on newly created maps from authoritative completed player flights, not launch or preview data.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_BiotechMechsCreated: Mechanoids manufactured only after the relevant Biotech action actually completes.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_BiotechBirthMothers: Colonists who gave birth only after the relevant Biotech action actually completes.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_BiotechChildStages: Child growth milestones only after the relevant Biotech action actually completes.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_BiotechMechRepairs: Fully completed mech repairs only after the relevant Biotech action actually completes.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_BiotechWasteCreated: Toxic wastepacks actually produced only after the relevant Biotech action actually completes.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_BiotechWasteDisposed: Wastepacks safely neutralized only after the relevant Biotech action actually completes.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_BiotechPollutionCleaned: Cells cleaned by colonists only after the relevant Biotech action actually completes.
LanguageData.RWS_Exp_Enable: Record all available statistics (on by default)
LanguageData.RWS_Exp_Warning: Unverified captures are collected by default. Some integrations can miss or double-count records or add CPU overhead; unavailable MODs are skipped. Prior events cannot be reconstructed.
LanguageData.RWS_Exp_Help: All units are selected for new installations. Uncheck an item to opt out of that collection; turning off a unit does not delete its recorded history. Changes apply immediately, without restarting the game.
LanguageData.RWS_Mod_SourceUnavailable: Source MOD is not currently installed. Historical values are preserved; no new samples are recorded.
LanguageData.RWS_ModRecruitment_StartedDesc: Successful Recruitment 1.1.2 requests created after recording began. Historical periods before opt-in are partial. A cancellation after creation still counts as started.
LanguageData.RWS_ModRecruitment_ActiveDesc: Pending recruitment requests at the most recent successful save. This is not an all-time total.
LanguageData.RWS_ModHospitality_PresentGuestsDesc: Number of active Hospitality guests across player home maps at a successful save. Not a lifetime visit total. No change to the guest MOD is required.
LanguageData.RWS_ModHospitality_PresentGroupsDesc: Number of active Hospitality guest groups across player home maps at a successful save. Not a lifetime visit count.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_CraftedByDef: Successfully completed product units by item during the recorded period. An independent series; no historical estimate for time before activation.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_MinedByDef: Successfully placed mining yield by item during the recorded period. An independent series; no historical estimate for time before activation.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FilthRemoved: One per filth object completely removed by a player pawn's cleaning job (vanilla MessesCleaned record). Not a count of partial thickness reductions or entire cleaning jobs. Recorded only while enabled.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FiresExtinguished: One per fire destroyed by a player pawn through vanilla fire-fighting or self-extinguish (FiresExtinguished record). Environmental fire extinction is excluded. Recorded only while enabled.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_MealIngestions: Successful positive-nutrition ingestion calls for meals eaten by player-faction humanlike pawns. Each call counts once, including consumption in a caravan, but not non-meal food, drugs, or non-player pawns.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_HaulPlacements: Successful placement actions for player HaulToCell jobs at the selected destination cell. Partial coverage: container deposits and mod-specific hauling methods are not counted. A pickup alone is never counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_HauledUnits: Total items successfully dropped during player HaulToCell deliveries, measured by the change in carried stack count. Partial coverage: container hauling and other transport modes are not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_CleaningJobsCompleted: Successful completion of a player pawn's cleaning job after at least one filth object was fully removed. Multiple filth objects in one job count as one job. Interrupted jobs are excluded.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_TreeWoodPlaced: Number of primary wood units actually placed or merged after a player's tree-cutting harvest, measured by GenPlace's placedAction. Partial coverage: bonus wood from some MOD components and nonstandard cutting paths are excluded.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_SlaughteredButchery: Counts successfully completed vanilla ButcherCorpseFlesh recipe consumptions of an animal corpse previously recorded as slaughtered by a player pawn. Identifies the exact corpse across saves. Excludes hunted, wild-death and enemy corpses. Partial: MOD butcher recipes and some corpse disappearance paths are not recognized.
LanguageData.RWS_CrossDesc_MaxColony: Highest recorded value across independent colonies, using one representative observation per colony. Missing readings are not treated as zero. State quantities refer to each colony's recorded save, not cumulative production.
LanguageData.RWS_CrossDesc_MinColony: Lowest recorded value across independent colonies, using one representative observation per colony. Only actually measured zeros can win; unknown and non-applicable values do not.
LanguageData.RWS_CrossDesc_TopType: Sum quantities separately for each item definition across independent colonies, then rank those totals. Counts use one representative observation per colony. Missing, overflowed, or untracked definitions give partial coverage. State inventories and lifetime events are not interchangeable.
LanguageData.RWS_CrossDesc_TopCategory: Summed counts for each recorded category across independent colonies, using one representative observation per colony. Incomplete and missing category splits remain Partial; categories are not item counts.
LanguageData.RWS_CrossDesc_Sum: Sum of separately measured state quantities at the representative saved moment of each independent colony. This is not a lifetime event total. Unknown readings never become zero.
LanguageData.RWS_Hospitality_VisitGroups: Hospitality: lifetime guest groups arrived (since activation)
LanguageData.RWS_Hospitality_VisitGroupsDesc: Number of confirmed visiting Hospitality groups arriving at player home maps since this addon was enabled. Rescued guests given replacement groups are excluded. Replays use hashed event IDs. No pre-install history is inferred.
LanguageData.RWS_Hospitality_VisitGuestsDesc: Total visiting pawns in confirmed Hospitality groups arriving at player home maps since this addon was enabled. Repeat visits count again; this is not a unique-person count or the current number of guests. Historical visitors before activation are unknown.
LanguageData.RWS_Hospitality_VisitsCompleted: Hospitality: peacefully departed visiting groups (since activation)
LanguageData.RWS_Hospitality_VisitsCompletedDesc: Counts non-hostile Hospitality groups after the visiting toil ends, an actual map exit is observed and the lord disbands with no remaining members or other losses. Sent-away and recovered groups are excluded. A load during departure may lack enough evidence and is omitted, never guessed.
LanguageData.RWS_Hospitality_RecruitedDesc: Confirmed Hospitality guest adoptions since opt-in, counted only after the upstream Recruit action returns with a player-faction pawn. No historical backfill.
LanguageData.RWS_Hospitality_ForcedRecruitDesc: Confirmed Hospitality guest recruitments marked forced by the target, since opt-in. A subset of successful recruitments.
LanguageData.RWS_Hospitality_VoluntaryRecruitDesc: Confirmed Hospitality guest recruitments not marked forced by the target, since opt-in. A subset of successful recruitments.
LanguageData.RWS_Hospitality_ShoppingUnitsDesc: Items added to guests’ inventory or equipment by completed shopping jobs on player home maps since opt-in.
LanguageData.RWS_Hospitality_ShoppingSilverDesc: Silver taken from guests by the same completed shopping jobs since opt-in.
LanguageData.RWS_Hospitality_AssignedBedsDesc: Number of distinct guest beds assigned to currently present Hospitality visitors across player home maps at successful save. Shared beds are counted once. This is bed assignment, not a measure of guests physically sleeping or of lifetime bookings.
LanguageData.RWS_AddonRecruitment_StartedDesc: Confirmed recruitment requests after opt-in; distinct from the legacy built-in series because event deduplication/checkpoint keys changed.
LanguageData.RWS_AddonRecruitment_SilverSpent: Recruitment: silver spent on started requests (since activation)
LanguageData.RWS_AddonRecruitment_SilverSpentDesc: Total confirmed silver paid for newly created Recruitment drives since opting in. Includes premiums; does not count failed attempts or represent net wealth.
LanguageData.RWS_AddonRecruitment_PlannedApplicants: Recruitment: planned applicants in requests (since activation)
LanguageData.RWS_AddonRecruitment_PlannedApplicantsDe: Total candidates rolled when paid Recruitment drives start, since opt-in. This is the planned applicant count, not people who actually arrived, joined, or became colonists; generation may fail.
LanguageData.RWS_DBH_PipedStorage: Dubs Bad Hygiene: stored piped water (L)
LanguageData.RWS_DBH_PipedStorageDesc: Total liters physically stored in unique Dubs Bad Hygiene pipe-connected water tanks across player home maps at a successful save. Includes only available connected tanks; not lifetime production or usage. Values from before enabling the addon are not reconstructed. Unknown if source data cannot be read.
LanguageData.RWS_DBH_PipedCapacity: Dubs Bad Hygiene: piped tank capacity (L)
LanguageData.RWS_DBH_PipedCapacityDesc: Total maximum water capacity in liters of distinct pipe-connected tank components across player home maps at the latest successful save. Not a lifetime quantity.
LanguageData.RWS_DBH_PumpCapacityDesc: Sum of source-defined potential pumping capacity of unique populated pipe networks at a successful save, in liters per RimWorld day. This is capacity, not actual water produced.
LanguageData.RWS_DBH_GroundwaterCapacity: Dubs Bad Hygiene: groundwater supply capacity (L/day)
LanguageData.RWS_DBH_GroundwaterCapacityDesc: Sum of source-defined water inlet/groundwater capacity in liters per game day across populated unique pipe networks at a successful save. Not the actual amount pumped.
LanguageData.RWS_SAU_OrdersIssuedDesc: Number of automatic vanilla Wear jobs actually issued by Smart Apparel Upgrade. This is NOT the number of successfully completed apparel changes. Only events after enabling collection are counted. Experimental statistics.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ModdedIncidentsByDef: Confirmed incidents from non-vanilla MODs that succeeded on a player home map after experimental collection was enabled. Split by package ID and incident definition; not the existing vanilla disaster counters. Historical gaps are not backfilled.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_OutpostsActive: Number of active player-controlled Vanilla Expanded Framework Outposts in a successful save. Across colonies, sums representative saved states; not a lifetime count or a measure of items produced or received. Experimental; no backfilling.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FishingActions: Player fishing jobs on home maps that placed at least one catch. A bonus catch from the same job adds items only.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_FishingCatchByDef: Items actually placed by player fishing jobs on home maps, including rare catches and supported Vanilla Fishing Expanded bonuses. Only recorded periods are covered.
LanguageData.RWS_Backup_ConfirmRestore: Restore the backup from {0} (MOD {1}, {2} colonies, {3} observations)? The current record will be backed up first.
LanguageData.RWS_Backup_ImportBusy: Wait for the current import to finish, or cancel it.
LanguageData.RWS_Backup_RestorePreferences: Also restore favorites and colony group settings
LanguageData.RWS_Fav_Empty: Use the star beside a statistic or overview card to add it here.
LanguageData.RWS_Fav_Unknown: Previously saved metric is no longer available.
LanguageData.RWS_Fav_NoOverall: This metric has no combined value across colonies.
LanguageData.RWS_Rankings_PartialNote: Some observations are missing or partial.
LanguageData.RWS_Status_SdkEventCapExceeded: SDK event ID limit reached for {0} metric(s) (limit: {1}). Later events are not counted; totals are partial.
LanguageData.RWS_Status_Caution: A recorded value does not prove its numeric accuracy has been verified in-game.
LanguageData.RWS_Status_TargetIncompatible: Target MOD version or capture hook unsupported
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_VpeLevelsGained: Confirmed upward changes of player-faction VPE psycaster levels, counted after recording starts.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_VpePsycasters: Free colonists with a VPE psycaster implant at a recorded save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_VpeMaxLevel: Highest VPE psycaster level among free colonists at a recorded save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_VpeSumLevels: Sum of VPE psycaster levels of free colonists at a recorded save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_OutpostPawns: Player-owned outpost occupants at a recorded save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_OutpostByType: Player-owned outposts at a recorded save, grouped by world object definition.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_OutpostDeliveries: Nonempty production batches passed to outpost delivery. Items held locally or in transit may not have arrived.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_OutpostProducts: Production units passed to outpost delivery, by item.
LanguageData.RWS_Metric_DbhFixtures: Dubs Bad Hygiene fixtures by type
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_DbhFixtures: Player-owned Dubs Bad Hygiene buildings across home maps at a successful save.
LanguageData.RWS_Metric_DbhActivities: Completed Dubs Bad Hygiene activities by job
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_DbhActivities: Completed toilet, shower and audited washing jobs of player pawns on home maps since opt-in.
LanguageData.RWS_SAU_CompletedSwapsDesc: Automatic Smart Apparel Upgrade orders that finished equipping the chosen item since opt-in.
LanguageData.RWS_VTE_BankCreditsDesc: Net silver credited by completed VTE bank deposits, after bank fees, since enabling this experimental statistic. Contract payouts are excluded.
LanguageData.RWS_VTE_BankDebitsDesc: Gross silver debited from VTE bank accounts by successful withdrawals, before withdrawal fees, since enabling the statistic.
LanguageData.RWS_VTE_LoansIssuedDesc: Successfully issued VTE bank loans after enabling recording; failed requests and repayments are excluded.
LanguageData.RWS_VTE_LoanPrincipalDesc: Silver principal of completed VTE loan issues; repayment and interest are not included.
LanguageData.RWS_VTE_ContractDeliveries: VTE contracts fulfilled by delivering goods
LanguageData.RWS_VTE_ContractDeliveriesDesc: VTE NPC buy-order contracts where goods were actually consumed or carried away; merely accepting a contract is excluded. Reward crediting is not confirmed by this metric.
LanguageData.RWS_VTE_ContractItemsDesc: Item units handed over for completed or partially fulfilled VTE NPC buy-order contracts, including caravan pickups. Actual transfers, not requested amounts.
LanguageData.RWS_VTE_ContractPurchasesDesc: Player-posted VTE purchase contracts paid in full through VTE bank transactions and fulfilled with generated items. Cancelling payment or accepting a contract without settlement does not count.
LanguageData.RWS_VTE_ContractReceivedDesc: Units of items generated from successfully paid player-posted VTE purchase contracts, distinct from NPC buy-order deliveries and ordinary trade.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_VpeCasts: Successful Vanilla Psycasts Expanded ability casts by player free colonists, counted after VPE's ability-use consumption. Includes a count by ability type. Queued orders, cancelled casts and NPC casts are excluded.
LanguageData.RWS_VfeSecurity_TrapsRearmedDesc: Number of disarmed player-owned traps successfully rearmed during active play. Counts only a real disarmed-to-armed transition, not job orders, spawn initialization, debug operations or the upstream pawn record.
LanguageData.RWS_VaeAchievements_UnlockedDesc: New achievement cards unlocked during normal play, grouped by achievement definition. Debug unlocks and game-startup restore checks do not count.
LanguageData.RWS_VaeAchievements_PointsDesc: Achievement points actually credited by new non-debug unlocks. When the point manager cannot be read, the recorded amount is marked partial.
LanguageData.RWS_VfeTribals_EraAdvancesDesc: Successful forward increases of the player's tribal technology era. Initialization, equal or lower levels and save restores are excluded; grouped by era.
LanguageData.RWS_VfeTribals_CornerstonesDesc: New cornerstone definitions added with available points during active play. Existing unlocks and load restores are excluded; grouped by cornerstone.
LanguageData.RWS_VaeAspirations_CompletedDesc: Aspirations newly completed by player colonists through the MOD's normal completion check, grouped by aspiration definition. Debug completions, already completed or unassigned aspirations, and save restoration do not count.
LanguageData.RWS_VfeInsectoids_HiveBirthsDesc: New insects spawned by player-owned hives during normal colony ticking, grouped by insect kind. Cocoon replacement, restoring existing hive members and developer spawn actions do not count.
LanguageData.RWS_VqeCryptoforge_RelayScansDesc: Frozen Scanning Relay scans that reached completion while a player colonist was present on the quest map.
LanguageData.RWS_RimFactory_GroundOutput: RimFactory Auto Machine Tool ground output
LanguageData.RWS_RimFactory_GroundOutputDesc: Items confirmed placed on the map by player-owned Auto Machine Tools, grouped by item type. Direct transfers into conveyors or other machines are outside this statistic.
LanguageData.RWS_Rwom_HealingCasts: RimWorld of Magic successful healing casts
LanguageData.RWS_Rwom_HealingCastsDesc: Player Heal and Advanced Heal casts that actually reduced a target’s injuries or stabilized a fresh missing body part.
LanguageData.RWS_Sos2_OrbitArrivals: Save Our Ship 2 completed orbital arrivals
LanguageData.RWS_Sos2_OrbitArrivalsDesc: Player-controlled ships that reached a stable orbit after takeoff from the surface.
LanguageData.RWS_SimpleWarrants_CompletedDesc: Warrants settled through a player caravan hand-in after the target was removed and the warrant closed.
LanguageData.RWS_SimpleWarrants_SilverDesc: Actual silver added to a player caravan by rewards for completed warrant hand-ins.
LanguageData.RWS_VqeGenerator_UpgradesDesc: Completed player construction that replaces an existing player-owned ARC generator in place, grouped by the new generator type.
LanguageData.RWS_VehicleFramework_OwnedPeakDesc: Highest observed number of living player-owned Vehicle Framework vehicles per colony, including maps, caravans, flights and stashes. Recorded on successful saves. Vehicle types are shown for the save at the peak.
LanguageData.RWS_VfeDeserters_IntelPaidDesc: Ordinary intelligence items removed from player home-map stock by accepted Deserter Network payments.
LanguageData.RWS_VfeDeserters_CriticalIntelPaidDesc: Critical intelligence items removed from player home-map stock by accepted Deserter Network payments.
LanguageData.RWS_VfeClassical_SenatorFavors: VFE Classical senator favors newly gained
LanguageData.RWS_VfeClassical_SenatorFavorsDesc: Previously unfavored senators who become favored through normal diplomacy or quests, grouped by faction. Developer actions, already favored senators and historical save restoration do not count.
LanguageData.RWS_VfeEmpire_HonorsBestowedDesc: Pending VFE Empire honors actually bestowed on a player colonist at completion of a ritual, grouped by honor definition. Merely receiving an available honor or developer actions are excluded.
LanguageData.RWS_Vsie_AspirationsCompletedDesc: Newly completed aspirations tied to the colonist's active inspiration in Vanilla Social Interactions Expanded, grouped by inspiration. Incomplete progress, expiration and unrelated inspirations do not count.
LanguageData.RWS_GiddyUp_MountSessionsDesc: Player colonists who successfully start riding owned animals through a completed Giddy-Up Mount job, grouped by animal kind. Pre-mounted arrivals, queued commands and repeat observations do not count.
LanguageData.RWS_CombatExtended_ReloadsDesc: Completed player-pawn reload actions that actually move ammunition into a weapon magazine. Each DoReload action counts once even when it loads several ammo stacks. Turrets, auto-loaders, disabled ammo and failed actions are excluded.
LanguageData.RWS_VreAndroid_AwakeningsDesc: Player-owned synthetic-body androids that naturally become awakened through the mood-based gene tick, excluding direct developer awakening, startup and already-awakened state. Requires Biotech.
LanguageData.RWS_VseExpertise_SelectedDesc: New expertise specializations selected by player colonists in the normal expertise panel, by ExpertiseDef. Debug unlocks and restored records are excluded.
LanguageData.RWS_VseExpertise_LevelUpsDesc: Positive permanent increases in VSE expertise levels earned after recording was enabled, summed across all independent colonies and grouped by ExpertiseDef.
LanguageData.RWS_VseExpertise_Highest: VSE highest expertise level ever reached
LanguageData.RWS_VseExpertise_HighestDesc: The largest expertise level actually attained through XP progression among independent colonies, not a sum of levels or a snapshot of the latest save.
LanguageData.RWS_VefCooking_BatchesDesc: Completed VEF soup, cheese and other independent processes owned by Vanilla Cooking Expanded, grouped by ProcessDef. Ordinary bill crafting and partially blocked output are excluded.
LanguageData.RWS_VefBrewing_Batches: Vanilla Brewing fermentation and aging batches
LanguageData.RWS_VefBrewing_BatchesDesc: Completed VEF fermentation, brewing and aging batches owned by Vanilla Brewing Expanded, grouped by ProcessDef. Paused, blocked or unfinished output and generic bill crafting are excluded.
LanguageData.RWS_Gastronomy_SilverCollectedDesc: Silver actually transferred by a non-player restaurant customer for a meal at a player-owned restaurant. Partial payments contribute their transferred amounts; uncollected debts, free meals and unrelated trade do not count.
LanguageData.RWS_VqeDrones_AssembledDesc: Player-owned drones actually spawned by the automated drone assembler when its production timer finishes, by pawn kind. Mere timer progress, failed spawn and egg hatching are excluded.
LanguageData.RWS_VqeDrones_HatchedDesc: Player drones actually born through successful egg hatching, by pawn kind. Destroyed eggs without a spawned drone and independently assembled drones are excluded.
LanguageData.RWS_VceDeepchem_StoredUnits: Vanilla Chemfuel Expanded Deepchem accepted into pipes
LanguageData.RWS_VceDeepchem_StoredUnitsDesc: The actual fractional Deepchem units accepted into pipe storage by a player-owned pumpjack, measured at PipeSystem's successful storage call. Requested yield, ground placement and blocked storage do not count.
LanguageData.RWS_VgeExtraction_ItemsPlaced: Vanilla Genetics Expanded DNA extraction outputs
LanguageData.RWS_VgeExtraction_ItemsPlacedDesc: DNA items actually placed or merged by successful player-controlled extractions, by output ThingDef. Invalid targets, failed placements, charge consumption without output and other hybrid creation do not count.
LanguageData.RWS_VnpeGrinder_SlurryStored: VNPE nutrient slurry stored in pipes
LanguageData.RWS_VnpeGrinder_SlurryStoredDesc: The actual fractional nutrient slurry units accepted into the pipe network by player-owned Vanilla Nutrient Paste Expanded grinders. Grinder attempts, ingredient consumption without accepted slurry and pipe storage by other buildings do not count.
LanguageData.RWS_VfeMedieval2_HoneyItemsDesc: Honey units successfully placed or merged after a player colonist unloads a player-owned Medieval2 apiary, grouped by output ThingDef. Production readiness, failed placements and later hauling are excluded.
LanguageData.RWS_VfeSecurity_ArtilleryLaunched: VFE Security cross-map artillery projectiles launched
LanguageData.RWS_VfeSecurity_ArtilleryLaunchedDesc: Successful target-map projectile launches from player-owned off-map artillery when a traveling world shell arrives, grouped by projectile definition. Target orders, transit without arrival and shots with no spawned projectile do not count. This does not measure target hits.
LanguageData.RWS_VfeFactory_HarvestedDesc: Items newly harvested by a player-owned Autofarmer, including real harvest-buffer increases and confirmed ground placement, grouped by output ThingDef. Later hopper offloading, rejected placement and generic pawn harvesting are excluded.
LanguageData.RWS_VfeFactory_SownDesc: New plants actually spawned, marked sown and matched to the selected crop during a player Autofarmer ProcessRow, grouped by plant ThingDef. Unsuccessful rows and old plants are excluded.
LanguageData.RWS_VfePirates_WarcasketFitsDesc: Fully completed player Warcasket fittings through normal welding, confirmed by project clearing and three newly worn matching pieces, grouped by armor Def. Incomplete jobs, partial outfit application and developer completion are excluded.
LanguageData.RWS_VqeAncients_RejectedDesc: Rejected player Archogen Injector outcomes whose occupant was released alive with actual injection coma. Canceled work, a selected outcome without successful completion, and pending gene-success choices are excluded. Requires Biotech.
LanguageData.RWS_VqeAncients_MutationsDesc: Player Archogen Injector mutation outcomes that destroy the original pawn and spawn one player-owned mutant of the chosen PawnKindDef, grouped by mutant kind. Other spawns, cancellations and pending success choices are excluded. Requires Biotech.
LanguageData.RWS_VfeSettlers_BountyHandins: VFE Settlers bounties successfully turned in
LanguageData.RWS_VfeSettlers_BountyHandinsDesc: Player caravan wanted criminals or bodies actually turned in and removed while receiving a positive silver reward. Opening the command, missing subjects, failed transfers and unrelated belongings do not count.
LanguageData.RWS_VfeSettlers_BountySilver: VFE Settlers bounty silver actually received
LanguageData.RWS_VfeSettlers_BountySilverDesc: Silver actually added to the player caravan by the first reward transfer in a successful VFE Settlers wanted-person hand-in. Excludes the criminal's items and any silver in those belongings.
LanguageData.RWS_Rimatomics_Byproducts: Dubs Rimatomics reprocessing by-products actually placed
LanguageData.RWS_Rimatomics_ByproductsDesc: Items actually placed or merged as by-products during a player-owned plutonium processor's completed fuel unload, grouped by output ThingDef. Returned spent fuel, merely processed material and unrelated placements do not count.
LanguageData.RWS_CE_RoundsUsedDesc: Real rounds deducted from player-colonist weapon magazines or destroyed through direct-feed shooting, grouped by AmmoDef. Reload movements, dry fires, turret consumption and debug ammo replenishment do not count.
LanguageData.RWS_CE_SuppressionReceived: Combat Extended new suppression on player colonists
LanguageData.RWS_CE_SuppressionReceivedDesc: Player-colony pawns newly entering the Combat Extended suppressed state, counted once per transition out of an unsuppressed state. Repeated suppression while already suppressed and developer test suppression are excluded. This measures suppression received, not suppression inflicted on enemies.
LanguageData.RWS_VfePirates_HireContractsDesc: New pirate or mercenary contracts actually committed by Vanilla Expanded Framework's hiring window for a Pirates-owned hiring faction. Dialog views, canceled offers and failed payments do not count.
LanguageData.RWS_VfePirates_HireSilver: VFE Pirates silver actually paid for hires
LanguageData.RWS_VfePirates_HireSilverDesc: Silver actually removed from player-map inventories when a new VFE Pirates hire contract is registered, rather than its rounded quoted price. Free contracts contribute zero silver.
LanguageData.RWS_VgeHybrid_BirthsDesc: Exactly one new player-owned hybrid pawn actually spawned when a player-owned VGE electro-womb completes a successful growth cycle, grouped by pawn kind. Failed growth, timer progression and load restoration are excluded.
LanguageData.RWS_VgeHybrid_ConversionsDesc: Successful player-owned mechahybridizer transformations that destroy the original subject and spawn one new player-owned converted pawn, by resulting pawn kind. Machine activation, waiting progress and failed spawn are excluded.
LanguageData.RWS_PrisonExpanded_ParoleApprovedDesc: Parole-hearing Release decisions that successfully clear a due sentence for a living prisoner still in player custody, with the actual release interaction enabled. Mere hearings, extensions, recruit options, repeated choices and later physical departures do not count.
LanguageData.RWS_Rimefeller_ExtractedFieldUnits: Rimefeller crude extracted from oil fields (field-capacity units)
LanguageData.RWS_Rimefeller_ExtractedFieldUnitsDesc: Actual reduction of an oil field's CurrentCap during successful processing of a player-owned oil derrick's Pump action. These are oil-field capacity units, NOT pipe-volume or inventory item units. No drilling progress, attempted pumping, passive field regeneration, tank transfer or refinery output is counted.
LanguageData.RWS_PrisonExpanded_SentencesServedDesc: Number of player-held prisoner sentences that actually reach their imposed duration in Prison Expanded and first enter parole-hearing-due state. Parole approval, release orders, repeated days, and loaded values do not count.
LanguageData.RWS_PrisonExpanded_PhysicalDeparturesDes: Recorded Prison Expanded prisoners who physically leave a player home map through a successful Pawn.ExitMap, rather than receiving a release or parole instruction. Includes an actual departure regardless of the original sentence.
LanguageData.RWS_Rimefeller_RefineryFuelUsedDesc: Actual decrease in pipeline FuelAvailable caused by player-owned Rimefeller refinery processing, measured after the pipe component base tick. Excludes fuel transferred into on-site machines during the base tick and any scheduled or attempted consumption. Units are pipeline fuel units.
LanguageData.RWS_Rimefeller_PlantFuelUsedDesc: Actual decrease in pipeline FuelAvailable during successful fuel draws by player-owned Rimefeller powerplants. Dry or failed draws are excluded. Units are pipeline fuel units rather than inventory items.
